source.title: 128. Milosrđe Božje - Odreći se i samoga sebe radi spasenja!

summary.title_hr: 128. Milosrđe Božje - Odreći se i samoga sebe radi spasenja!
summary.abstract_hr: Epizoda medija Ora et Labora, emitirana u srijedu 4. studenoga, počinje molitvama: oslobađanjem od zlih sila, posvetom Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu, Krunicom Božanskog milosrđa, litanijama Božjem milosrđu i slavnim otajstvima Gospine krunice. Slijedi tumačenje odlomka iz Poslanice Filipljanima. Voditelj iz njega izdvaja pojmove koje smatra ključnima za spasenje: poslušnost Bogu, strah i trepet, život bez mrmljanja i bez oklijevanja, pripremu za dan Kristov (posljednji sud) i radost. U tumačenju evanđelja (Lk 14,25-33) objašnjava da 'mrziti' roditelje i bližnje znači prezreti ljudski obzir u pitanjima vjere te da imovinu treba staviti u službu kraljevstva Božjega. Na kraju najavljuje promocije knjige i predstavljanja domoljubne inicijative po hrvatskim gradovima, poziva na članstvo i donacije te čita svjedočanstvo jedne slušateljice.
key_points: Voditelj iz Poslanice Filipljanima izdvaja pojmove koje smatra ključnima za spasenje: poslušnost Bogu, strah i trepet, život bez mrmljanja i bez oklijevanja, svijest o danu Kristovu (posljednjem sudu) i radost. Slušatelje poziva da te pojmove zapišu i preispitaju se.

Strah Božji objašnjava kao svijest da čovjek može za vječnost propasti u pakao. Poziva se na duhovne vježbe svetog Ignacija i tvrdi da mu je Gospodin u duhu pokazao pakao te da ga je to iskustvo promijenilo.

Tvrdi da je mrmljanje zapravo proklinjanje i da je većina mladih iz Hrvatske i Bosne i Hercegovine otišla zbog mrmljanja roditelja, a ne zbog ekonomske situacije. Roditelje poziva da se djeci ispričaju.
Kritizira takozvani 'duh Asiza' i otvaranje Crkve drugim religijama. Ističe da je Isus jedini spasitelj i da je cilj pape Wojtyle bio pozvati druge religije na obraćenje.
Riječi o 'mržnji' prema roditeljima, supružniku i djeci (Lk 14) tumači kao prezir prema ljudskom obziru u pitanjima vjere. Ako je nečije mišljenje važnije od Isusova, to naziva idolatrijom.

Ističe da imovina treba služiti širenju kraljevstva Božjega. Kao primjer navodi da obitelj s jednim djetetom u stanu od 150 kvadrata može prodati stan, kupiti manji, a višak uložiti u posao, dati Crkvi ili nekoj inicijativi. Dodaje da djeci ne treba davati sve jer okolnosti siromaštva bolje odgajaju.

Najavljuje promocije knjige i predstavljanja domoljubne inicijative Ora et Labora u Imotskom, Pazinu, Umagu (umjesto ranije najavljenih Buja), Valpovu, Novoj Gradiški, Bjelovaru i Samoboru. Poziva na članstvo, donacije i kupnju knjiga za dovršetak međunarodnog edukacijskog centra Kraljica Mira u Međugorju.
key_topics_en: prayer of the chaplet of divine mercy
grumbling and emigration of young people
key_points_en: The host singles out from the Epistle to the Philippians concepts he considers key to salvation: obedience to God, fear and trembling, a life without grumbling and without hesitation, awareness of the day of Christ (the last judgment), and joy. He invites listeners to write down these concepts and examine themselves.

He explains the fear of God as an awareness that man can perish into hell for eternity. He refers to the spiritual exercises of Saint Ignatius and claims that the Lord showed him hell in the spirit and that this experience changed him.

He claims that grumbling is actually cursing and that the majority of young people from Croatia and Bosnia and Herzegovina left because of their parents' grumbling, and not because of the economic situation. He calls on parents to apologize to their children.

He criticizes the so-called 'spirit of Assisi' and the opening of the Church to other religions. He emphasizes that Jesus is the only savior and that the goal of Pope Wojtyła was to call other religions to conversion.

He interprets the words about 'hatred' toward parents, spouse, and children (Lk 14) as contempt toward human respect in matters of faith. If someone's opinion is more important than Jesus', he calls that idolatry.

He points out that property should serve the spread of the kingdom of God. As an example, he states that a family with one child in a 150-square-meter apartment can sell the apartment, buy a smaller one, and invest the surplus in business, give it to the Church, or to an initiative. He adds that children should not be given everything because circumstances of poverty bring them up better.

He announces book promotions and presentations of the Ora et Labora patriotic initiative in Imotski, Pazin, Umag (instead of the previously announced Buje), Valpovo, Nova Gradiška, Bjelovar, and Samobor. He invites to membership, donations, and book purchases for the completion of the Queen of Peace international education center in Međugorje.
summary.title_en: 128. God's Mercy - Renounce Even Oneself for the Sake of Salvation!
summary.abstract_en: An episode of the Ora et Labora media, broadcast on Wednesday, November 4, begins with prayers: deliverance from evil forces, consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary, the Chaplet of Divine Mercy, the Litany of Divine Mercy, and the Glorious Mysteries of Our Lady's Rosary. A commentary on a passage from the Epistle to the Philippians follows. From it, the host singles out concepts he considers key to salvation: obedience to God, fear and trembling, a life without grumbling and without hesitation, preparation for the day of Christ (the last judgment), and joy. In his interpretation of the gospel (Lk 14:25-33), he explains that to 'hate' parents and neighbors means to despise human respect in matters of faith, and that property should be put at the service of the kingdom of God. At the end, he announces book promotions and presentations of the patriotic initiative throughout Croatian cities, invites to membership and donations, and reads the testimony of a female listener.
